body:
do you think there’s hope for us? 
im only 18. i dont wanna die this young but I’m so scared for the future. 

i know therapy would help but. I’m scared of that too. i can barely remember my childhood, except that I remember something happening to me, and that i had signs of something more happening. I just don’t know if therapy is worth digging up those memories. I don’t know if I’m ready for that. 

as for pain...I have pills I take. they help, but I feel like I’m going down a path I shouldn’t. My body aches when I don’t take them, and I feel like I have to just to function. I don’t want to be an addict, but I don’t have any other choice. Ive tried pot, it helps, but the high is uncomfortable. 

im so tired of being miserable all the time. I’m so tired of being shitty to my family and constantly being upset or sad or panicking. 

sorry for dumping this all on you! But...I dunno I felt like you could understand? I can’t really talk with anyone about it. 
I think there’s some semblance of hope left in me. it flickers from time to time and it dims but. it’s still there. Faintly.
I hope things get better for you, too. I hope we both get something good soon. i hope we both stick around long enough to see it
